list.title: Inspections
list.subtitle: Planned and recurring checks of workplaces, equipment and routines, with the results, scores and findings they produced.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search inspections by code, title or location

templates.title: Checklist templates
templates.subtitle: Reusable checklists your inspections are built from. Start from the library, build your own or let the assistant draft one.
templates.searchPlaceholder: Search templates by code or title
templates.publishMessage: Once published, the template can be used to plan inspections and schedules. Later changes to its questions raise the version; inspections already planned keep their own copy.
templates.archiveMessage: An archived template can no longer be used for new inspections. Existing inspections are not affected.
templates.deleteMessage: "{{ title }}" will be deleted and its schedules stopped. Inspections already performed keep their answers.
templates.draftNotice: This template is a draft. Publish it to use it for inspections.
templates.archivedNotice: This template is archived and can no longer be used for new inspections.
templates.notFound: This template does not exist or you cannot see it.
templates.askImprove: Review the questions of the checklist template "{{ title }}". Are they clear, checkable and complete for their purpose? Suggest improvements.

library.title: Template library
library.subtitle: Ready-made checklists to start from. Import one as a draft, adapt it to your sites and routines, then publish it.
library.failed: The template library could not be loaded.

builder.generateTitle: Draft a checklist with the assistant
builder.generateIntro: Describe what the checklist is for, or name a standard clause, and the assistant drafts the questions. Nothing is saved until you add them to the template and save.
builder.generatePlaceholder: For example: a monthly walk-through of the warehouse, covering forklifts, racking, walkways and first aid.
builder.appendGenerated: Add them after the existing questions
builder.generatedNotice: Review every question before you publish: the draft is a starting point, not a finished checklist.
builder.empty: No questions yet. Add one below, import a template from the library or let the assistant draft them.
builder.noQuestions: This checklist has no questions yet.
builder.findingOnFail: Raise a finding when it fails
builder.versionNotice: Changing the questions or pass mark of an active template raises its version. Inspections already planned keep the questions they were created with.
builder.fixProblems: Fix the highlighted problems before saving ({{ count }}).

problems.weight: The weight must be between 0 and 100.
problems.scale: The highest score must be greater than the lowest.
problems.passScore: The passing score must lie within the scale.
problems.range: The maximum must not be below the minimum.
problems.id: Use only lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '_' in the id.
problems.server: This question was not accepted. Check its settings.

form.noTemplates: There are no active checklist templates yet.

detail.notStarted: This inspection has not started yet.
detail.cancelMessage: A cancelled inspection stays on record but can no longer be performed.
detail.deleteMessage: {{ code }} and its findings will be deleted. Follow-up tasks of the findings are cancelled.
detail.notFound: This inspection does not exist or you cannot see it.
detail.askExplain: Explain the results of inspection {{ code }}: what failed, what it means and what should happen next.

run.readOnly: You can view this inspection but not perform it. Ask its inspector or a manager.
run.autoStart: Answers are saved as you go. Your first answer starts the inspection.
run.closed: This inspection is closed. Answers can no longer be changed.
run.missingIntro: Answer the required questions first ({{ count }}):
run.findingsWithDeviations: Failed answers: {{ count }}. Each raises a finding, and the findings become deviations.
run.findingsOnly: Failed answers: {{ count }}. Each raises a finding.
run.uploadFailed: The photo could not be uploaded. Try again.

signature.name: Full name of the person signing
signature.optional: Drawing is optional; the typed name is the signature.

findings.title: Findings
findings.subtitle: Problems found during inspections, who owns them and whether they became deviations.
findings.searchPlaceholder: Search findings by code or title
findings.deleteMessage: {{ code }} will be deleted and its follow-up tasks cancelled.

schedules.title: Recurring inspections
schedules.subtitle: Schedules plan the next inspection from a template automatically, so routine checks are never forgotten.
schedules.deleteMessage: No further inspections will be planned. Inspections already planned are kept.

notices.imported: "{{ title }}" was imported as a draft.
notices.generatedApplied: The drafted questions were added. Review them, then save.
notices.escalated: A deviation was created for finding {{ code }}.
